verdict.rationale: Apple's macOS page describes built-in Siri AI that works on the user's own data. It can find photos, emails, and notes, answer questions about on-screen content such as images and PDFs, give feedback on what the user has written, act in apps based on current context, and group tabs into topics automatically. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing copy, evidence of proactive or analytical insights over user data (versus retrieval and drafting), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
